title: WHEN HANDS GROW HEAVY
A MIDDAY PRAYER FOR STRENGTH
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon

scenes.a: Your arms are tired from holding everything up.
scenes.sub: THE WEIGHT YOU CARRY AT NOON

scenes.a: In the middle of the day, heavy responsibility presses down.
Scripture records: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon;
and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
Lord, when our strength gives out, raise up support around us. Establish our hearts in Your peace through this afternoon.
Amen. Your arms are tired from holding everything up.
